verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes an llms.txt index at developer.alloy.com/public/llms.txt, which lists docs such as SAML SSO/SCIM and entity merging, and it serves its docs as raw markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. The 404 probes are at different paths (root /llms.txt and a malformed .md.md URL), so they do not contradict the /public/llms.txt file. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the canonical root path (root returns 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
